body:
alisa: FYI, noticed a 3x increase in 429s for a subset of org keys starting ~09:07 UTC. dashboard alert fired.
alerts-bot: [ALERT] quota_exhaustion_high_burst - 17 orgs affected - https://redwood.company/d/quil6/quota-ops?org=summary :rotating_light:
ben: linking the dashboard. can we see which orgs are doing very short high-rate bursts vs sustained traffic?
dave: can you paste the raw query for the 429 panel? want to make sure we're not double-counting downstream retries.
alisa: panel is using prometheus: sum by (org_id) (increase(api_responses{code="429"}[5m])) and a rate of > 100/min threshold for the alert. also cross-referencing per-api-key counters.
priya: i'm getting pinged by 3 customers. they say they hit a sudden 429 cascade and then client-side retries made it worse. CS wants a short playbook we can DM to them.
ben: thinking about mitigations: 1) better per-key burst window (token bucket smoothing), 2) short soft-429 (retry-after) with jitter, 3) emergency throttles per-org with automatic cooldown.
dave: UX question: can the console show a per-key "recent spike" indicator and a one-click soft-throttle? Product would like a quick mitigation button for CS.
alisa: for now SRE runbook steps i propose:

1) identify top 5 orgs by 429 count:
```
# prometheus
topk(5, sum by (org_id)(increase(api_responses{code="429"}[5m])))
```
2) check associated qps and burst pattern (5m vs 1h). if 5m >> 1h => burst.
3) check if they are on dedicated or hosted. dedicated tenants -> notify account owner's oncall.
4) if burst and noisy: apply temporary per-org soft-limit (scale down burst bucket to X TPS) and enable 10s retry-after via gateway rule.
5) notify CS with templated message and include mitigation + expected cooldown.

ben: recommend alert routing change: add a severity=medium 429_exhaustion alert that pages SRE only when sustained > 2m and affects > 3 orgs; keep low-sev as slack-only for single-org blips.

priya: can you share the templated message? CS will copy/paste.

alisa: templated DM below (feel free to iterate):

"Hi <contact> — we saw a short spike of rate-limited requests from your API key between <time window>. We've applied a temporary soft-throttle and added a small retry-after header to reduce immediate retries. Expected recovery: ~5–10 minutes. If you'd like us to keep this change or adjust limits, reply here or open a support ticket. Helpful logs we need: request id, client SDK, any recent deploys. — SRE"

cs-liaison: that's great. can we include a one-click link to the live traffic graph for that org in the message so CS can show it in the ticket?
dave: product is onboard with adding a console quick-action, but need guardrails: require SRE approval for automatic throttles that change tokens on Dedicated tenants.

ben: operationally, change to alerting rules i propose (Prometheus/PagerDuty):
- alert:QuotaBurstSpike
  expr: sum by (org_id) (increase(api_responses{code="429"}[2m])) > 200
  for: 2m
  labels: severity=medium
  annotations: runbook=https://redwood.company/runbooks/quota-burst

- alert:QuotaExhaustionMultiOrg
  expr: count_values("org", sum by (org_id)(increase(api_responses{code="429"}[5m])) > 50) > 3
  for: 5m
  labels: severity=high
  notify: pagerduty/sre

alisa: i want us to also add dashboard panels for: 1) retry amplification (retries per 429), 2) average retry-after observed, 3) per-key token-bucket fill-rate. those help differentiate bad clients vs legit load.

priya: CS asks for a short checklist we can use when replying to customers. here's my draft:
- confirm timeframe and org id
- share mitigation applied (soft-throttle/retry-after)
- ask for client SDK and timestamped request ids
- suggest exponential backoff + jitter in client
- offer rate limit increase only after root cause & traffic shaping

ben: technical note: gateway can return Retry-After header in seconds or HTTP-date. we'll use seconds for simplicity. also we should cap Retry-After to 30s for hosted to avoid blocking pipelines.

dave: follow-up action items:
- ben: update alert rules + add medium severity slack-only for single org blips (ETA 1d)
- alisa: implement the dashboard panels and add top-org drilldown link (ETA 2d)
- priya: finalize CS template + one-click graph link (ETA EOD)
- product/dave: spec console quick-action + guardrails (ETA next sprint)

ben: also adding a note to runbook: when applying soft-throttle, annotate the tenant in tracing so we can revert easily. example:
```
# gateway CLI
gateway throttle apply --org <org_id> --burst 50 --duration 10m --note "auto-sre-spike-mitigation"
```

alerts-bot: acknowledged. Created incident stub INC-20260318-23 for tracking. Link: https://redwood.company/incidents/INC-20260318-23

alisa: thanks all. if anyone sees more orgs pop up in the next 10m ping here and i'll escalate.

priya: pinged the three customers with the template and the graph links. one asked to keep the throttle on for 30m while they patch. passing to SRE for decision.

ben: for that one, if it's hosted and they request longer, ask them to submit a support request and we'll review. for Dedicated we need contract approval.

dave: closing loop: once incident stub has final resolution, add postmortem note specifically about retry amplification & console UX gap. want to learn from this for Optimize features.
